title: Schedule
description: A recurring run of one saved plan: when it fires, how much it may spend and who hears about it.

ScheduleNotify.description: Where a finished scheduled run is announced.

slack.description: Post the summary to the Slack webhook set in Settings.
slack.title: Slack

ScheduleNotify.title: ScheduleNotify

plan_id.description: The saved plan this schedule runs.
plan_id.title: Plan

tier.description: commit runs from CI through run-now with depth smoke and no judge; nightly and weekly run on a cron.
tier.title: Tier

cron.description: Five-field cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) read in the schedule time zone: numbers, ranges, lists, steps and month and weekday names; day of month and day of week cannot both be restricted. Required for nightly and weekly; the commit tier takes none.
cron.title: Cron

timezone.description: IANA time zone name such as Europe/London. The cron is read in this zone.
timezone.title: Time zone

enabled.description: A disabled schedule keeps its settings and does not fire.
enabled.title: Enabled

budget.description: Optional ceilings for each run; the plan budget applies when empty.
budget.title: Budget

notify.description: Where a finished run is announced.
notify.title: Notify
